title: Meeting and marrying his wife
summary: He met his wife at a club on Shrewsbury Road in 1948 and they married in 1949.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Uh-huh. So. So what, what, what, what, what year were you married? When were you married?
I got married, uh, March 20th, 1949. Remember that.
Your anniversary was just a few days ago.
Oh. What did I tell you? Basically, I forgot.
Uh-oh. Okay, well, what was that? Sure was. That's not saying too loud then, Tommy.
Oh, sure, March 29th. Oh, I'm going to mention it to, she probably, she remembers.
So how'd y'all meet? How'd you meet your wife?

Well, my wife came down here from, uh, from up in, uh, Laplace. Uh-huh. Months. And, uh, everybody, all the fellas was impressed. See, we used to go over to, over to this little club, and listen to, uh, Bama play music. That was the band I was going to try to remember. I can't remember nobody but Bama and Mio, that little old man played a bass. But anyway, and we, all of our youngs used to go in this club. And my wife was the little pretty girl, cab down here from Laplace. Had a long headway out here, and everybody was impressed with me. So everybody tried to take out, and nobody was successful but me. So where, where was this club? It was on, they called it Severn Avenue, Shrewsbury Road, by, by, by, by, by, Gennaro's play. That's the same man that had my daddy killed, and then his club. And, uh, and that's how, that's how I met her. And, uh, we danced, you know. And then, uh, when they got me up there to sing, you know, and I was singing, I guess that helped me to, come together. Cause then, this was, I guess, this was maybe 1948. It was, it had to be, it was 1948 because, and then we were married in 49. Mm-hmm. She was pregnant.
But anyway, uh, and you know, in all these years we've been married, we've never been separated.
